name: session-manager-dev
description: The default end-to-end development skillset for the Claude Code Session Manager: decompose work into scheduler PRDs (/develop), hand a finding to another project on this machine (/send-feedback), rank what to work on next in a shared repo (/find-opportunity), roll up operational status and optimize the North-Star KPI (/project-status, /optimize-kpi, /local-project-health), gate with review (/requesting-code-review, /security-review), document how the project works (/explain-to-me), and keep the auto-memory store clean (/memory-sanitation). Together with the session-manager scheduler these form a closed develop → queue → track → review → status → improve loop.
